blockers.blocker: timed human review and correction-yield results
blockers.plan: Compare review time per finding and correction yield against the legacy baseline over the first 10 real activated cases, read from the review pages. Closes after those 10.
Re-validate every activated case's locators on a schedule (scripts/validate-case.py over the case root) and track the revalidation rate.

blockers.evidence: A dry run of scripts/migrate-source-expressions.py on copies of 19 local legacy cases migrated 0 findings: 18 were refused at legacy input validation and the remaining case had 0 mappings and 23 skips. Old cases are forward-only.

Producers write passages only through scripts/write-source-expressions.py, which merges by expression id under the case lock and publishes atomically. tests/source-expression-writer-check.py injects a failure mid-publish (the previous file survives byte for byte, no temporary file remains), fails the second file of a two-file publish (the first is put back), and runs six writers at once (no update is lost; with the lock removed the same test loses updates). Case-contract writes use the same lock and publish the contract last.
blockers.scope: Measured on macOS (POSIX flock). The Windows lock path (msvcrt) has not been run yet.

blockers.blocker: implemented comparison of the two alternative storage shapes
blockers.evidence: Batch 1.1 fixes the separate-record shape (source expressions as their own records linked to claims), so the embedded alternatives are no longer candidates.

stop_thresholds.review_time_and_correction_yield: compared with the legacy baseline over the first 10 real activated cases
stop_thresholds.stop_rule: When a threshold is breached, new cases start in legacy mode until the producer is fixed. An activated case never falls back to legacy.
